taskType.description:
In this task we would like you to trace the axon starting at the task position through the dataset.

Hints:

- Place a node at least every 10 slices and at every branch point.
- Mark branch points with **B** and follow every branch to its end.
- Ignore dendrites and glia; stay within the axon.
- Leave a comment on nodes where the axon leaves the dataset.

The full keyboard shortcuts can be found in the [documentation](https://docs.webknossos.org/webknossos/ui/keyboard_shortcuts.html).
